Title: AI Engineer
Description:
About 9fin
9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity
The Data Science team is growing at 9fin! We are doing world-class work with groundbreaking technologies to build data-driven products using machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, speech and audio, and knowledge/data mining. We are looking for a AI Engineer to accelerate our application of AI across teams and products. Come and join us, you will get to build large-scale AI powered systems, learn and apply the latest techniques, and work alongside other great researchers and engineers!
Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

- Design and build generative AI applications tailored to complex financial and legal workflows, leveraging state-of-the-art models to deliver innovative, practical solutions that streamline decision-making and unlock new efficiencies.

- Drive end to end model development lifecycle, leading the team in best practices, ensuring reproducible research and well managed model delivery/deployment.

- Collaborate cross functionally to share diverse ideas, understand business problems, and elevate/mentor your teammates.

- Translate complex problems into well-defined scoped bets in an internal startup style environment, dynamic and fast-paced.

- Learn and apply ground-breaking research and approaches in advanced topics, iterating improvements with a fail fast mentality.

- Be a proactive sharer of compelling ideas/work to the rest of the team and organisation. We want you to help lead/push the adoption of AI throughout 9fin.

About You
This role will be a great fit if you:

- Strong proficiency in Python for production ready delivery.

- You’re an expert in any of the following areas - deep expertise in one and familiarity with others is ideal:

- Information Retrieval: chunking strategies, (finetuning) embedding models, training re-rankers.

- Entity/relationship extraction/resolution

- Knowledge Graphs; building and inference, graphRAG

- Recommendation systems and ranking: personalisation, learning-to-rank, feed ranking, user modelling, etc.

- Tabular ML: feature engineering, structured data modelling (GBDTs, etc.)

- Statistical & Predictive Modelling: supervised ML, anomaly detection, temporal modelling, etc.

- Deep understanding of the GenAI landscape and agentic frameworks.

- Experience working in the full model lifecycle (including experimentation, training, testing, monitoring, and deployment). We are data centric and love our evals!

- You have a strong product focus with a desire to understand the end-to-end impact of your solutions for our end users.

- Good knowledge of AWS’s AI infrastructure.

Benefits
We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.
Financial & Insurance

- Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

- Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

- Private Medical Insurance

- Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

- Group Life Assurance

- Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

- 25 holiday days per year

- Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

- Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

- Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

- 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

- Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

- Professional learning and development budget

- AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

- Quarterly team socials

- Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy
9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer
At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

About this role

Join our Partner Algorithms team and help build the intelligence behind Just Eat's marketplace, powering personalised experiences for tens of millions of customers across 14 countries. This is your opportunity to deliver end-to-end machine learning solutions that directly impact customer engagement and order growth.
We're building JET's recommendation systems, generating personalised carousels of restaurants to help people find their order right on the home page of the app. We're looking for someone who can live our behaviours of lead, deliver and care while bringing technical excellence and innovation.
This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge AI as we integrate, train and develop ML and generative models into a live production environment. Help us compute data at scale for millions of users to help people find the food they want.

We need someone who can challenge assumptions, translate ambiguous business problems into elegant technical solutions, and ship production-quality ML systems that make a measurable difference to our customers and partners.

These are some of the key components to the position:

- Self-starter attitude comfortable with autonomy and ambiguity, thriving in fast-paced environments where you can build rapidly, test rigorously and roll out successes at scale.

Title: Lead Data Scientist
Description:
Lead Data Scientist, Obsero
UK, remote, full time. £80,000 to £100,000 plus equity.
Find out why AI recommends one brand over another. Turn our AI search data into the GEO playbook, the recommendation engine and the models that tell customers what to do next.
About Obsero
Obsero is one of the UK's leading AI search startups. We track how brands are cited and recommended across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and Claude, so marketing teams can see where they stand in AI answers and what to do about it.
The problem
Every day our platform runs thousands of prompts across the major AI platforms and records what comes back: which brands get mentioned, which sources get cited, how they are described and how that changes over time. It is now one of the richest datasets on AI search anywhere. Today the platform tells customers where they stand. The question every marketer actually wants answered is why an LLM recommends one brand over another, and what they should do about it. Your job is to answer it, and to take the platform from insight to action.
Why join now

- We've just raised $1.2m, led by SFC Capital, to build specialist AI agents trained on the GEO playbook from a year of client work
- In our first year we captured and analysed over 10 million AI answers, and that number is growing fast
- You'll be the first data scientist, so you'll set how we turn that data into insight
- Meaningful equity, alongside a salary of £80,000 to £100,000
The role
This is a lead role reporting to a founder. You will own the problem end to end, from a clean, trusted dataset through to models running in the product. Our lead data engineer owns how the data is captured, cleaned and stored, so your time goes on what it means rather than on fixing it.
What you'll own

- The GEO playbook: using our historic prompt data to understand what drives LLMs to recommend one brand over another, separating the factors that genuinely move visibility from the ones that only look like they do
- The recommendation engine: productising Obsero's GEO recommendation engine in the platform, and measuring whether recommendations work so results feed back into the engine
- Predictive models: predicting the likely impact of different actions for each customer, so they know what to do first
- New insight: exploring new ways to analyse the data, prototyping quickly and turning the best ideas into features
This is not a reporting or dashboarding role. We want someone who asks better questions of the data than we do, and builds the models and products that answer them.
What you'll need

- Several years of hands-on data science, with a track record of taking models from analysis into production
- Strong Python and SQL, comfortable building the analysis and feature pipelines your models need
- Statistical modelling, causal inference or experimentation, and the judgement to tell correlation from cause in messy, real-world data
- Experience with recommendation systems, ranking or predictive modelling
- Hands-on with LLMs and NLP, and properly curious about how AI platforms decide what to recommend
- The ability to explain complex findings clearly to marketers, consultants and founders
- Product-minded, focused on what will change a customer's results
- Comfortable owning a problem end to end in a small team
Nice to have

- An understanding of SEO or GEO
You'll need to be based in the UK with the right to work here.
What success looks like

- A GEO playbook grounded in evidence that our consultants and customers use
- A recommendation engine live in the platform, with customers acting on what it tells them
- Measurable improvement in customer visibility from the actions it prioritises
- Insight that sets Obsero apart from every other AI search tool
How we hire
Intro call with the Chief Product Officer, a technical conversation with our lead engineer, a presentation and then meeting the CEO.
How to apply
Apply through the link on this ad. Tell us briefly about a model you took from idea to production, and what difference it made.
